|errata_history=This is the original full face (version 1 of 4). The current full-face image and supported <code>207_4</code> are on [[Dice Ibegon (V) (Errata 2)]]. The source observations establish the documented sequence: original full face, sheet partial known by October 2021, November 2022 full face, September 2023 sheet partial. Capture dates and repository dates do not establish the first publication day of the older faces; the September 2023 date is the printed sheet edition. The partial layouts are separate published images even when the game words match a full face.
* '''Original''' (this page): The original full face is preserved from the Players Committee Holotable repository state <code>022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153</code>, known by 8 July 2018. It prints the dotted bottom label and no errata mark.<ref>[[:File:V7-L-diceibegon-2018-07-08.gif|Published full source face]], 8 July 2018 repository state.</ref> Game text: “Power +2 at a Jabba's Palace or Endor site. If just lost, place Dice in Used Pile. If opponent is about to draw destiny for an Interrupt targeting your character here, opponent must first lose 1 Force, then shuffle their Reserve Deck.”
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Dice Ibegon (V) (Errata)]]): The bottom-only sheet face is present in the complete source captured on 5 October 2021. It retains the dotted bottom label and prints no errata mark. Its upper face and artwork are intentionally omitted.<ref>[[:File:Virtual-Set-7-October-2021-capture.pdf|Official Set 7 source captured 5 October 2021]], page 2.</ref> Game text: “Power +2 at a Jabba's Palace or Endor site. If just lost, place Dice in Used Pile. If opponent is about to draw destiny for an Interrupt targeting your character here, opponent must first lose 1 Force, then shuffle their Reserve Deck.”
* '''PC-E2''' ([[Dice Ibegon (V) (Errata 2)]]): The current full face is preserved from the Players Committee Holotable repository state <code>a57375eaf483d0e05592c08185b77505a415f0e5</code>, dated 4 November 2022. The bottom label has no uniqueness dot. The game words are unchanged; it prints no errata mark.<ref>[[:File:V7-L-diceibegon.gif|Published full source face]], 4 November 2022 repository state.</ref> Game text: “Power +2 at a Jabba's Palace or Endor site. If just lost, place Dice in Used Pile. If opponent is about to draw destiny for an Interrupt targeting your character here, opponent must first lose 1 Force, then shuffle their Reserve Deck.”
* '''PC-E3''' ([[Dice Ibegon (V) (Errata 3)]]): The September 2023 printed sheet edition publishes the bottom-only face with the undotted bottom label and no errata mark.<ref>[[:File:Virtual-Set-7-September-2023.pdf|Official Set 7 sheet, September 2023 edition]], page 2.</ref> Game text: “Power +2 at a Jabba's Palace or Endor site. If just lost, place Dice in Used Pile. If opponent is about to draw destiny for an Interrupt targeting your character here, opponent must first lose 1 Force, then shuffle their Reserve Deck.”
